title: Abubatsi b'iminara
intro: Mu gihe cyashize, ubukungu bukomeye bwarazamutse, burangwa n'ibikorwa byabwo bitangaje byo kubaka n'imbaraga zikomeye. Uyu muryango wahawe umutungo mwinshi n'ubuhanga bufatika, nyamara bahisemo inzira yo kwigomeka ku butumwa bw'Imana bwoherejwe kugira ngo bubayobore. Inkuru yabo ni isomo rikomeye mu mateka, ni igihamya cy'ingaruka zo kwanga ukuri.
clues: Twahawe imbaraga n'uburebure bihebuje by'umubiri, bitandukanye n'abandi bantu bo mu gihe cyacu.
Twari tuzwiho kubaka inyubako nini n'inkingi ndende ahantu hose ho hejuru, twibwira ko tuzabaho iteka ryose.
Intumwa yoherejwe muri twe kugira ngo ituburire, iduhamagarira gusenga Allah wenyine no kureka ibigirwamana byacu.
Twabajije intumwa yacu twishimye, tubabaza niba baje kuri twe kugira ngo badusenge Allah no kureka ibyo ba sogokuruza basengaga.
Ubutaka bwacu bwari bufite ubusitani, amasoko n'imirima yera, ariko ubutunzi bwacu twabwishyize mu mbaraga zacu, ntabwo twabwishyize mu Muremyi wacu.
Kubera ko twakomeje kutemera no gushinyagurirwa, amaherezo twarimbuwe n'umuyaga uteye ubwoba kandi ukaze wabaye mwinshi iminsi myinshi n'amajoro menshi.

outcome.answer: Yararimbuwe n'umuyaga mwinshi kandi ukaze cyane

arabic: فَأَمَّا عَادٌۭ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ ٱلْحَقِّ وَقَالُوا۟ مَنْ أَشَدُّ مِنَّا قُوَّةً ۖ أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَهُمْ هُوَ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةًۭ ۖ وَكَانُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا يَجْحَدُونَ
verse: As for ʿAad, they were arrogant upon the earth without right and said, "Who is greater than us in strength?" Did they not consider that Allāh who created them was greater than them in strength? But they were rejecting Our signs. (41:15)
